# SOLREIGN Employee Handbook
Welcome to the wing of the Handbook the Company would prefer you read [italic]before[/italic] an incident, not after.
- This section covers every Solreign-specific terminal, board, and system you can find aboard: what it is, where to find it, and the exact steps to your first success.
- Nothing here is a spoiler. If you are hunting for something stranger than a vending machine, the Company cannot help you, and neither can this page.
- Sections: - The Directive Terminal (the Oracle) - Requisitions Anonymous (the black market) - The Liability Board (bounties) - Wingmates (first-shift buddy system) - Salary & Standing (your permanent record, but friendlier) - The Season Ledger (titles and rank)
- For your actual first shift — canteen, Contracts Board, admin-help keybind — see [textlink="Your First Shift at Solreign" link="SolreignFirstShift"] first if you have not already.
- Reopen this guide anytime with [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenGuidebook"][/bold][/color].
